onChange.script:
if currentValue.value["period"].value != "":
		# if value in dropdown changes (but not empties, set start/end time to the bound start and end time)
		self.custom.exchange.launchpad.oee.display.customTime.start = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["start"].value)
		self.custom.exchange.launchpad.oee.display.customTime.stop = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["stop"].value),-1)

if currentValue.value["period"].value != "":
		# if value in dropdown changes (but not empties, set start/end time to the bound start and end time)
		self.custom.exchange.launchpad.oee.report.customTime.start = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["start"].value)
		self.custom.exchange.launchpad.oee.report.customTime.stop = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["stop"].value),-1)
